beats.care: Buying sweets? Check the label and packing date, and pick shops that look clean.
beats.what: Over three days, officials checked 286 units and outlets and collected 383 samples. On Saturday alone, 100 units were checked.
beats.why: Demand for sweets spikes in the festive season, and so do hygiene shortcuts.
